description: Get top cryptocurrency coins by market cap from CoinGecko (no API key required).

count.description: Number of top coins to return (default: 50, max: 250)

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = all fields

limit.description: Maximum coins per page; omitted = curated default (25)

name: get_crypto
title: Top Cryptocurrencies
